viewportLimit: Chrome requires integer CSS viewport dimensions. This uses measured innerWidth/innerHeight and DPR; saved Android fractional visualViewport differs by 0.091/0.273 CSS px. Native screenshot widths remain separate.
checks: Production notes page transition finished; computed transform none
